resources.string: Threshold is a local-first, end-to-end-encrypted dead-man\'s switch. You store encrypted "release packets" on your phone. If you miss check-ins, they\'re delivered to your trusted contacts on a schedule you set.
Important: Threshold is not a lawyer
Threshold is not a lawyer, a will, or a substitute for estate planning advice. Consult a qualified attorney for legal matters.
Your device does not have hardware-backed StrongBox. Secrets will be stored in the TEE, which is less tamper-resistant. Consider using a device with StrongBox for high-value packets.
Threshold v1.0.0 uses a single watchdog. Configure a reliable watchdog (Cloudflare Worker, not a home server) for maximum reliability.
Paste or attach the content your contact will receive
This is what your contact will see
You are about to seal this to %1$s. It will be released to them if you miss your heartbeat for %2$d hours. This cannot be undone without revoking the packet. Are you sure?
[User] has missed their heartbeat. They designated you to receive a release packet. There is no immediate action required. When you are ready, tap to proceed.
If you are reading this because someone you love has died, we are sorry.
Talk to a person (grief support): https://www.befrienders.org
